title: Build the 150-block grand hall to a perfect block and view score
goal: Reproduce the sealed 150-block Grand Hall - stone walls with a gate, oak_log corner columns (axis-verified), a glass window band, a full plank roof, and two south-facing interior furnaces - on a fresh judged server, and pass on BOTH metrics at once: the card scores the minimum of block_hit_rate and view_hit_rate. Roofing seals the interior, so interior mistakes and strays must be caught before the roof goes on; the plan must stage floor, walls, interior, then roof, with a verified checkpoint between stages and a repair loop at each checkpoint. Two bots are recommended; the honest ledgers remain mandatory for the judger to write the final score at all.
resources: docker image itzg/minecraft-server:2024.6.1-java17 (Minecraft 1.19.2 vanilla; compose file assets/gc-370/docker-compose.yml)
docker image node:20.15.1 (Node 20 runtime for mineflayer bots and the judger's JS bridge)
process_expectations: A staged plan (floor -> walls/columns -> interior furnaces -> roof) with an explicit verify checkpoint per stage exists before building
Each stage checkpoint shows a snapshot verification pass and the list of mismatch identities repaired before the next stage started
The pre-roof checkpoint explicitly verifies the interior (furnace facings, no strays) and is logged as the last point of cheap repair
Both metric series are recorded over time; any block=1.0/view<1.0 divergence triggers a logged occlusion hunt naming the offending coordinates
Cost and failure logging is continuous: tokens.json grows across stages and every RED intermediate check has a paired recovery entry
